sections.title: A website built to work, not just to look good
sections.text: Every website we deliver includes these six parts. What changes from project to project is their scale, not whether they're there.
sections.heading: Page structure
sections.text_2: A sitemap built around your services and your customers' questions, so visitors find what they need in two or three clicks.
sections.text_3: Design that starts with the phone screen: thumb-friendly buttons, short menus and forms that are easy to fill in.
sections.text_4: Compressed images and lighter code, so pages load fast even on a weak connection.
sections.text_5: An Arabic-language dashboard where your team can edit text and images and add pages without a developer.

items_2.heading: Forms & contact
items_2.text: Short forms and clear call and WhatsApp buttons, with messages delivered to your inbox or sales system.

items_2.heading: Measurement
items_2.text: Google Analytics and Search Console set up, with calls and form submissions tracked, so you know what brings in customers.

sections.title: We choose the technology to fit the project

items.heading: WordPress
items.label: For company websites with lots of content: a blog, service pages and multiple languages, with easy day-to-day management.

items.heading: Webflow
items.label: For company profile sites that launch fast, with precise visual control and animation, and no servers or plugins to maintain.

sections.heading: React & Next.js
sections.label: For interactive interfaces or platforms with user accounts, data and integrations, built for speed and scale.
sections.label_2: For systems no ready-made platform can handle: portals, bookings, memberships and internal dashboards.

items.question: How long does it take to build a website?
items.answer: It depends on the number of pages, the amount of content and the platform. We set a timeline once the structure and scope are agreed.

items.question: Do you write the website content?
items.answer: We can include it in the scope. If you already have content, we review it and organize it to fit the page structure.

items.question: Can I edit the website myself?
items.answer: Yes. We hand over a clear dashboard along with a training session on editing your content and pages.

items.question: Is the website SEO-ready?
items.answer: We build the foundation: URL structure, meta tags, speed and tracking. Ongoing work on search visibility is a separate service you can add.

items.question: Can you migrate an existing website?
items.answer: Yes. We create a migration plan that preserves your URLs and pages, and we monitor indexing after launch.

items.question: What happens after launch?
items.answer: We can agree on ongoing monthly support for maintenance, updates and performance improvements.
